reasons.regional_outage: Ap-northeast has a 14.2% payment API error rate with customer-visible impact and an estimated 310 merchants affected.
reasons.response_plan: Failures are confined to ap-northeast and began shortly after REL-2210 reached full regional rollout, making a targeted rollback the most direct first mitigation.
reasons.technical_spread: Ap-northeast is explicitly degraded with failing checkout tests and a rising queue, while the other regions and database are healthy.
